title: Global coordination fails when neurons decouple in anesthesia and dreamless sleep

statements.text: In the conscious state, coupled layer 5 neurons let feedback at the apical dendrites shape somatic output, so activity spreads through the thalamo-cortical system. When the neurons are decoupled, as during anesthesia or dreamless sleep, that global coordination cannot happen.

sources.quote: DIT assumes that such global coordination cannot happen if L5 pyramidal cells are decoupled, e.g., during anesthesia or dreamless sleep
